plugins.name: distill-lessons
plugins.description: Review a finished stretch of work for durable lessons and write each one where it will actually be read — throwing most candidates away.

plugins.name: reconcile-records
plugins.description: Find and fix records that recent work made false — stale status lines, superseded numbers, notes that became re-derivable, state left unrecorded.

plugins.name: refile-rules
plugins.description: Reorganize a rule store whose structure stopped holding — overlapping sections, rules filed by feel, content in the always-loaded tier that had a trigger all along.
